title: Echoes react at your speed for each thing they do
summary: An echo now fights, shoots, builds and moves as quickly as you did each of those things in that life. A sharp swordsman who fumbled the bow leaves an echo that swings fast but is slow to shoot.
highlights: Shooting speed follows how often your arrows hit and how often you loosed them fully drawn
Anything you never did, your echo does at your usual pace
